svg.title: MARCUS VALÉRIO. what if we just made it?
svg.desc: The name Marcus Valério stays on screen while its full stop, a small blue square, leaves the signature and ricochets between the frame lines, pauses, then drops into place as the dot of a question mark. Its landing reveals the phrase: what if, in outline, and we just made it, in solid type. The phrase then clears and the square returns to the name.
